paper.title: DroidBot-GPT: GPT-powered UI Automation for Android
paper.central_claim: An off-the-shelf ChatGPT model can automate user-specified Android application tasks without further GUI training data, app/model modification or detailed step-by-step guidance, with greater flexibility and cross-category generalization than specialized prior systems.

signatures.object: Android UI structural observation and action grounding
signatures.information: DroidBot user-visible UI elements, text and properties from the view tree; no raw screenshot visual model.
signatures.operation: Serialize visible views into natural language; enumerate available element/action pairs with IDs; truncate element text20words; ask ChatGPT to select ID; map chosen ID to phone operation.
signatures.output: Click/long-click/check/scroll/edit operation bound to an enumerated element.
signatures.conditions: Required elements must appear with usable semantics in DroidBot tree; prompt must fit; app relations inferable from text.
signatures.feedback: Fetch new UI state after execution; no explicit correctness or confidence feedback module.
signatures.selection_rule: Model chooses ID; malformed response falls back to first extracted choice; cap20 selected through experiments.
signatures.data: 33 author-designed tasks,17 F-Droid apps; no GUI-model training data.
signatures.persistence: Static handcrafted serializer/parser; no accepted model update or persistent skill memory.
signatures.later_use: Rules reused across benchmark apps; within-episode state is refreshed.
signatures.claimed_effect: Translate UI/task into an already language-capable model’s input without app/model modification.
signatures.failure_boundary: Unnamed checkmark absent from tree cannot be acted on; ambiguous relationships and wrong first-choice extraction remain.

signatures.information: Task, current enumerated UI choices, full recorded action history and desired response format.
signatures.operation: Prompt for next choice; on edit, issue a second text-generation query and type returned string; repeat on next observed state.
signatures.conditions: Off-the-shelf ChatGPT can infer target choice; history and response constraints sufficient to avoid loops; token budget not fully specified.
signatures.feedback: Next visible state, not separate judge/reward.
signatures.selection_rule: No cross-episode candidate selection or learning; historical actions condition current prediction.
signatures.data: Task descriptions and current interaction history; exact ChatGPT snapshot/settings not reported.
signatures.persistence: History during task only; no evidence of persistent improvement between tasks.
signatures.later_use: Subsequent steps read history, but no stored outcome-indexed memory.
signatures.claimed_effect: High-level goal automation without step-by-step instructions.
signatures.failure_boundary: Redundant operations, early termination, stochastic model response and edit-target ambiguity.

claims.text: Automates high-level Android tasks without additional GUI training.
claims.setting: ChatGPT with DroidBot UI tree, choice IDs/history and optional second typing call; real F-Droid apps.
claims.control: No serializer/history/truncation/action-space ablation; inherits closed-model prior knowledge.
claims.selection_vs_test: 33 author-designed tasks in17 apps;20-word cap chosen from experiments; no independent development/test app partition.
claims.result: 13/33 complete according to reference-path comparison; average matching-prefix progress66.76%.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Feasibility of structural-text prompting for this task set, not a verified general Android success rate or causal improvement over prior methods.

claims.text: Greater flexibility/generalization and complex tasks with minimal instructions.
claims.setting: Cross-category F-Droid evaluation with one prompted model.
claims.baseline: Prior specialized/mobile-instruction systems discussed but not measured.
claims.control: No category/app construction holdout, no pretrained-exposure audit, no matched instruction granularity baseline.
claims.selection_vs_test: Same author-designed app/task suite used for setup experiments and reporting without separate partition.
claims.result: 60% full completion for2–3-step tasks vs20% for6–13-step tasks; missing controls and relations cause failures.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Some multi-app feasibility shown; comparative generalization, broad scaling and priority are unestablished.

gap.author_gap: Prior Android automation is specialized/training-heavy or requires detailed instructions; generic pretrained LLM abilities need a usable UI/action interface.
gap.checked_gap: An actual Android structural-to-language bridge and executable loop are described, but no matched prior-system comparison establishes greater flexibility/generalization or priority. The view-tree bottleneck persists.

readable_rationale: 可运行的贡献是把 DroidBot 的结构树与动作编号写成任务/历史 prompt，并以第二次调用补全文本输入。33题中13题完整路径展示了可行性，不能把66.76%的前缀进度当成功率。无对照、无消融、无独立应用留出和重复运行统计；结构树漏控件构成硬边界。online 仅指作者实际手机执行与参考路径核对，不意味着已具备 AndroidWorld 式状态验证。
